overview: 本期共收录 12 篇论文。研究方向主要集中在金融经济学（8 篇）、绿色金融与可持续发展（2 篇）、货币政策与宏观经济（1 篇）。方法上以数值模拟、实验方法为主。来源分布：arXiv（9 篇）、Semantic Scholar（3 篇）。

papers.title: An Integrative Multidimensional Conceptualization of Telework Behavior: A Systematic Review and Grounded Theory Approach
papers.abstract: Telework has expanded rapidly, and understanding the behaviors employees enact under it has become correspondingly important. This study develops an integrative conceptual framework specifying the multidimensional nature of telework behavior. A systematic literature review following PRISMA identified 114 review articles, which were analyzed using constructivist grounded theory. Six behavioral dimensions were identified, covering performance, communication, environmental, task, policy, and well-being conduct. Antecedents were grouped into individual factors, job characteristics, organizational norms, technological factors, and work environment factors. Outcomes were grouped into job satisfaction, productivity, turnover, health and well-being, work-life balance, and social isolation. Three contextual moderators were identified, namely telework modality, telework preference, and cultural and national context. Fourteen propositions link these categories and are advanced as testable claims rather than established findings, since they are derived from published review evidence and have not been empirically tested. The framework proposes telework behavior as the construct through which the conditions of remote work are translated into employee and organizational outcomes, and it specifies a content domain from which measures of the construct can be developed. It also indicates where organizations can direct policy, training, and intervention.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】远程工作发展迅速，因此了解员工在远程工作环境下的行为变得尤为重要。本研究构建了一个综合性的概念框架，用以阐释远程工作行为的多元维度特征。通过遵循PRISMA方法进行的系统文献回顾，共筛选出114篇相关研究论文，并运用建构主义扎根理论对这些论文进行了分析。研究确定了六个行为维度，包括工作表现、沟通方式、工作环境、工作任务、相关政策以及员工的工作幸福感。这些行为的影响因素被归纳为个人因素、工作特性、组织规范、技术因素以及工作环境因素三类。远程工作的结果变量则涵盖工作满意度、工作效率、员工流动率、健康与幸福感、工作生活平衡以及社交隔离等方面。此外，研究还识别出三个情境调节变量，分别是远程工作模式、员工对远程工作的偏好，以及文化与国家背景。研究提出了14个理论命题，将这些行为维度与结果变量联系起来，并将其视为有待验证的假设（而非已确立的结论），因为这些命题是基于已发表的文献综述得出的，尚未经过实证检验。该框架将“远程工作行为”视为一个核心概念，通过这一概念可以将远程工作的各种条件转化为员工和组织层面的实际结果，并明确了可用于衡量该行为的测量指标。同时，该框架也为组织在政策制定、员工培训及...。

papers.title: On testing the incentive compatibility of single-parameter allocation mechanisms
papers.abstract: This paper is the first work at the intersection of game theory and property testing, giving algorithms and lower bounds for efficiently testing whether an allocation mechanism is incentive compatible (IC). We propose distinguishing whether a mechanism is $ε$-far from being IC, i.e., when it observes many monotonicity "violations." Conceptually, inspired by the literature on Boolean function monotonicity testing, we construct a tester for discrete single-parameter allocation rules. Technically, our work is the first to consider monotonicity testing of vector-valued functions on the hypergrid. We give a $\tilde{O}(n/ε)$-query algorithm to test whether a function (representing n-player allocation mechanisms) is coordinate-wise monotone versus $ε$-far from it. We also show a matching lower bound: the class of coordinate-wise monotone vector-valued functions on a Boolean hypercube or hypergrid requires $\tildeΩ(n/ε)$ queries to test whether it is $ε$-far from monotonicity, and this holds even if the tester is two-sided and allowed to make adaptive queries. Finally, we extend our upper bound to and give a tester of the same query complexity for pricing functions of allocation mechanisms. This requires overcoming the technical challenge that the path in function space to the closest IC mechanism may involve interdependent changes to both the price and the allocation rule.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本文是首次将博弈论与属性测试相结合的研究成果，提出了用于高效判断分配机制是否具有激励相容性（Incentive Compatibility, IC）的算法及下界。我们提出了一种方法，用于判断某种分配机制与理想激励相容机制之间的差距是否达到$\epsilon$水平，即该机制是否存在大量违反单调性条件的情况。在概念上，我们借鉴了布尔函数单调性测试的相关理论，设计了一种用于离散单参数分配规则的测试工具。从技术层面来看，我们的工作首次实现了对超网格（hypergrid）上向量值函数的单调性测试。我们提出了一种$\tilde{O}(n/ε)$复杂度的查询算法，用于判断一个表示多玩家分配机制的函数是否具有坐标单调性，或者该函数与理想激励相容机制之间的差距是否达到$\epsilon$水平。同时，我们还给出了一个相应的下界：在布尔超立方体（Boolean hypercube）或超网格上，要判断一个坐标单调的向量值函数是否与理想激励相容机制存在$\epsilon$水平的差距，至少需要$\tildeΩ(n/ε)$次查询；即使测试工具具备双向查询能力并允许进行自适应调整，这一下界仍然成立。最后，我们将...。

papers.title: Barriers and Instruments of Green Financing for Small and Medium-Sized Enterprises: An Analytical Literature Review
papers.venue: Highlights in Business, Economics and Management
papers.abstract: Small and medium-sized enterprises are the main sources of employment, production and local innovation, but they have been neglected by the sustainable finance system. This paper offers an analytical literature review of the barriers and instruments for SME green finance. It believes that the SME green finance gap is not only a lack of funds. Instead, it is the result of the interaction among general SME credit frictions, the special characteristics of green projects, weak internal capabilities, and the transaction costs of environmental verification. The four sources of the literature for this review are SME finance theory, eco-innovation, the energy-efficiency gap, and green finance policy. It builds a taxonomy of barriers, maps financial and non-financial instruments to these barriers, and compares selected cases from China, India, Colombia, Ireland and the European Union (EU), along with firm-level projects supported by the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD). Therefore, stand-alone green loans are not suitable for small and medium-sized enterprises. Good designs combine finance and risk sharing, technical support, project preparation, performance guarantees and reasonable reporting systems. Finally, the paper points out research deficiencies in SME-specific causal evidence, green guarantee assessment, digital sustainable finance, and long-term firm-level effects.
papers.summary_zh: 【绿色金融与可持续发展】中小企业是就业、生产和地方创新的主要来源，但它们在可持续金融体系中一直未能得到足够的关注。本文对中小企业绿色金融所面临的障碍及相关政策工具进行了分析性文献综述。研究认为，中小企业绿色金融的困境并非单纯的资金短缺问题，而是由中小企业普遍存在的信贷摩擦、绿色项目的特殊性质、企业内部能力薄弱以及环境评估的交易成本等多种因素共同作用的结果。文献综述的主要来源包括中小企业金融理论、生态创新研究、能源效率差距分析以及绿色金融政策相关文献。作者构建了这些障碍的分类体系，梳理了针对这些障碍的金融与非金融工具，并对比了中国、印度、哥伦比亚、爱尔兰和欧盟（EU）的典型案例，以及欧洲复兴开发银行（EBRD）支持的企业级绿色项目。研究表明，单纯的绿色贷款并不适合中小企业；有效的绿色金融方案应结合融资与风险分担机制、技术支持、项目准备、绩效保障以及合理的报告体系。最后，本文指出了在中小企业特定情境下的因果关系研究、绿色担保评估机制、数字化可持续金融工具以及绿色金融对中小企业长期影响的评估方面仍存在的不足。。

papers.title: The Effect of Inflation and the Rupiah Exchange Rate on the Composite Stock Price Index for the 2013–2024 Period
papers.abstract: The purpose of this study is to determine the effect of inflation and the Rupiah exchange rate on the Composite Stock Price Index. The method used is a quantitative method. The sampling technique used in this study is saturated sampling. The sample used in this study is inflation data, the rupiah exchange rate, and the Composite Stock Price Index (IHSG) for the period 2013–2024 obtained from Bank Indonesia and Yahoo Finance. Data analysis uses classical assumption tests, regression analysis, correlation coefficients, determination coefficients and hypothesis tests. The results of this study are that inflation has no significant positive effect on the Composite Stock Price Index with a determination value or contribution of 0.282 or 28.2%. and the hypothesis test obtained t count < t table or (-1.984 < 2.228). The Rupiah exchange rate has a positive and significant effect on the Composite Stock Price Index with a determination coefficient or contribution of 0.669 or 66.9% and the hypothesis test obtained t count > t table or (4.501 > 2.228). Inflation and the rupiah exchange rate have a positive and significant effect on the composite stock price index with a regression equation of Y = -2623.251 – 19.237X1 + 618X2. The coefficient of determination is 0.671 or 67.1% while the remaining 32.9% is influenced by other factors. The hypothesis test obtained a calculated f value > f table or (9.174 > 4.260). Thus, there is a significant influence between inflation and the rupiah exchange rate on the composite stock price index.
papers.summary_zh:
【货币政策与宏观经济】本研究的目的是探讨通货膨胀和印尼盾汇率对综合股价指数（Composite Stock Price Index，简称IHSG）的影响。研究采用定量分析方法，并运用饱和抽样技术（saturated sampling）来选取样本数据。样本数据包括2013年至2024年期间的通货膨胀率、印尼盾汇率以及综合股价指数，这些数据来源于印度尼西亚央行（Bank Indonesia）和Yahoo Finance网站。数据分析过程中运用了经典假设检验（classical assumption tests）、回归分析（regression analysis）、相关系数（correlation coefficients）、决定系数（determination coefficients）以及假设检验（hypothesis tests）等统计工具。

研究结果表明：通货膨胀对综合股价指数没有显著的正向影响，其决定系数（determination coefficient）为0.282，即通货膨胀对股价指数的贡献率为28.2%；相应的假设检验结果显示t统计量（t count）小于临界t值（t table），即-...。研究方法：回归分析。

papers.title: Conformal Policy Learning with Distribution-Free Safety Guarantees
papers.abstract: Policy learning aims to determine who should be treated based on individual characteristics. In high-stakes settings such as medicine and public policy where safety is a central concern, improving the average outcomes alone may not be sufficient: decision makers may also seek to protect individuals from harm, in line with the Hippocratic principle of ``do no harm.'' In this paper, we propose \textit{conformal policy learning} (CPL), a policy learning procedure with a new distribution-free safety guarantee that controls the probability of assigning treatment to an individual who would be harmed relative to control. CPL views each treatment decision as testing a hypothesis of counterfactual harm and assigns treatment by thresholding conformal p-values. These p-values use observable proxies and selective calibration to address the challenge that the potential outcomes under comparison are never simultaneously observed. For randomized experiments, under standard exchangeability conditions, CPL provides finite-sample safety guarantee at a user-specified level, without imposing any outcome modeling assumptions. Moreover, when the outcome model is consistently estimated, CPL achieves asymptotically optimal welfare subject to the safety constraint. In observational studies, CPL with learn-then-balance weights achieves doubly robust safety guarantees. We evaluate CPL through extensive simulations and apply it to an empirical study of AI-powered interventions designed to reduce conspiracy beliefs.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】政策学习旨在根据个体特征确定应给予治疗的人群。在医学和公共政策等高风险领域，安全是核心关切，仅仅提高平均治疗效果可能并不足够：决策者还可能寻求保护个体免受伤害，这符合希波克拉底的“不伤害”原则。在本文中，我们提出了“共形政策学习”（Conformal Policy Learning，简称CPL）这一政策学习方法，它提供了一种新的、无需依赖具体分布的安全性保障机制，能够控制将治疗分配给可能受到伤害的个体的概率。CPL将每个治疗决策视为对“反事实伤害”假设的检验，并通过设定特定的共形p值（conformal p-values）来决定是否实施治疗。这些p值利用可观测的代理变量和选择性校准方法，解决了比较对象的结果无法同时被观测到的问题。对于随机实验，在标准的可交换性条件下，CPL能够在用户指定的安全水平上提供有限样本的安全保障，且无需对结果模型做出任何假设。此外，当结果模型能够被准确估计时，CPL能够在满足安全约束的前提下实现渐进最优的福利效果。在观察性研究中，采用“先学习后平衡”（learn-then-balance）权重的CPL方法能够提供双重稳健的安全保障。我们通过大量模拟验证了...。研究方法：数值模拟、模型校准、随机实验、实验方法。

papers.title: Mapping AI Economic Complexity
papers.abstract: Green economic complexity provides a generalizable framework for examining countries' productive capabilities in a defined product set. We apply this framework to AI-enabling goods within the full product space, linking current specialization with adjacent diversification opportunities. Using BACI exports for 2007-2023 and 103 AI-enabling goods, we measure complexity-weighted specialization (AECI), product-level adjacent opportunities (AIAP), and average complexity-weighted relatedness of remaining candidates (AECP). In 2023, Japan leads AECI, while China leads AECP; portfolio breadth accounts for much of the variation in raw AECI. Initial raw potential is positively associated with subsequent changes in the AI-enabling export share, but its associations with changes in AECI and specialization counts are not statistically significant at the 5% level. Our contribution is a trade-based assessment of AI-enabling productive capabilities and related opportunities. The results and public dashboard provide a preliminary complement to publication and patent indicators, not a comprehensive measure of national AI performance or a validated forecast of diversification.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】绿色经济复杂性为研究各国在特定产品范围内的生产能力提供了一个可推广的框架。我们将这一框架应用于所有产品领域中那些能够促进人工智能发展的商品，将当前的产业专业化与相关的多元化机会联系起来。利用2007至2023年的BACI出口数据以及103种能够促进人工智能发展的商品，我们测量了基于复杂性的专业化程度（AECI）、产品层面的相关多元化机会（AIAP），以及剩余商品之间的平均复杂性相关性（AECP）。2023年，日本在AECI方面处于领先地位，而中国在AECP方面表现最佳；产品组合的广度是影响原始AECI变化的主要因素。初始的潜在能力与后续人工智能相关出口份额的变化呈正相关，但其与AECI及专业化程度变化之间的关联在5%的统计显著性水平上并不显著。我们的研究为人工智能相关生产能力及其相关机会提供了基于贸易数据的评估。研究结果和公共数据面板为现有的出版物及专利指标提供了补充，但并不能全面反映一个国家的AI发展水平，也不能作为多元化的有效预测工具。。

papers.title: Causal Inference under Dynamic Selection: Time-Varying Covariates and Latent Heterogeneity
papers.abstract: I study dynamic treatment effects in panel data under staggered adoption when treatment timing depends jointly on unobserved time-invariant heterogeneity and time-varying pretreatment covariates, including lagged outcomes. Untreated potential outcomes follow a nonparametric dynamic panel model that allows flexible interactions between time-varying covariates and latent heterogeneity. I use pretreatment outcome histories to find individuals with similar time-invariant latent factors, and the key requirement is that these histories are sufficiently informative about those latent factors. I develop an identification strategy for the dynamic average treatment effect on the treated (ATT) and propose kernel-based doubly robust estimators for the dynamic ATT. I further combine double cross-fitting with undersmoothing and show that, under suitable regularity conditions, the proposed estimators are $\sqrt{n}$-consistent, asymptotically normal, and asymptotically unbiased. The simulation study demonstrates that the proposed method provides accurate inference across a wide range of data-generating processes. I illustrate the method with an application to the U.S. family planning program studied by Bailey (2012) and reestimate its effect on fertility rates.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】我研究了在交错采纳情况下的动态治疗效果，其中治疗时机同时受到未观测到的时间不变异质性和时变预处理协变量的影响，这些协变量包括滞后结果。未接受治疗的潜在结果遵循一个非参数动态面板模型，该模型允许时变协变量与潜在异质性之间进行灵活的交互作用。我利用预处理结果历史数据来识别具有相似时间不变潜在因素的个体，关键要求是这些历史数据能够充分反映这些潜在因素的特征。我提出了一种用于识别接受治疗个体的动态平均处理效应（ATT）的策略，并设计了基于核方法的双重稳健估计量。进一步地，我将双重交叉拟合技术与欠平滑处理相结合，证明了在适当的规则条件下，所提出的估计量具有$\sqrt{n}$-一致性、渐近正态性以及渐近无偏性。模拟研究表明，该方法能够在多种数据生成过程中提供准确的推断结果。我以Bailey（2012）研究的美国计划生育计划为例，重新估计了该计划对生育率的影响。。研究方法：面板数据、数值模拟。

papers.title: Empirical Bayes for compound adaptive experiments
papers.abstract: We investigate Empirical Bayes (EB) methods in the context of compound adaptive experiments, where the arm distribution in each experiment follows a normal distribution with an unknown mean that we seek to estimate. There are two main EB strategies: $g$-modeling, which estimates the prior by maximizing the marginal likelihood, and $f$-modeling, which derives posterior means directly from the empirical distribution of the observations. We show that $g$-modeling continues to be a valid EB procedure even when it incorrectly assumes that data are collected exogenously; its validity does not depend on the particular sampling algorithm or on whether sample sizes are endogenous. In practice, one can apply standard $g$-modeling techniques by acting as though the data were exogenously sampled. We extend regret guarantees from exogenous sampling to adaptively generated data. By contrast, naively applying the Tweedie formula based on the marginal density of the observed data, as in standard $f$-modeling, can produce biased rules under adaptive sampling. We corroborate the robustness of $g$-modeling through simulations with widely used adaptive algorithms and demonstrate its applicability using a real-world dataset consisting of multiple sequential experiments.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们研究了在复合自适应实验背景下基于经验贝叶斯（Empirical Bayes, EB）的方法。在这些实验中，每个实验中的“臂”（arm）分布遵循一个均值为未知的正态分布，我们的目标是估计这个均值。主要有两种EB策略：$g$-建模（通过最大化边际似然来估计先验分布）和$f$-建模（直接从观测数据的经验分布中推导后验均值）。我们发现，即使$g$-建模错误地假设数据是外生收集的，它仍然是一种有效的EB方法；其有效性并不依赖于特定的抽样算法或样本量是否为内生变量。在实际应用中，可以像数据是外生抽样的一样，使用标准的$g$-建模技术。我们将基于外生抽样的遗憾值（regret value）保证扩展到自适应生成的数据上。相比之下，如果像标准$f$-建模那样，仅基于观测数据的边际密度来简单应用Tweedie公式，那么在自适应抽样情况下可能会产生有偏的决策规则。我们通过使用广泛使用的自适应算法进行模拟来验证$g$-建模的稳健性，并通过一个包含多个连续实验的真实世界数据集来证明其适用性。。研究方法：数值模拟、实验方法。

papers.title: Rate-Agnostic Wald Inference for Dyadic Regressions
papers.abstract: This paper develops Wald inference for least-squares estimation of linear regression models on dyadic data, accommodating configurations where multiple observations share the same pair of units (e.g., directed flows, multilayer networks, and dyadic panels). We establish that the dyadic-robust Wald statistic is asymptotically $χ^2_q$ for an arbitrary nonrandom sequence of full-rank restrictions, under a single condition on the accumulation of dependence. Throughout, no convergence rate is assumed or estimated, permitting the condition number of the score's variance matrix to diverge. We further propose a delete-one-unit jackknife alternative that is positive semidefinite by construction. This jackknife statistic attains the same asymptotic limit under one additional condition on dyad multiplicity and remains asymptotically conservative when that condition fails. A supplement contains all proofs, Monte Carlo experiments featuring estimated coefficients that converge at heterogeneous rates, and an empirical gravity application to bilateral trade.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本文提出了用于二元数据线性回归模型最小二乘估计的Wald推断方法，该方法能够处理多个观测值共享同一单元的情况（例如，有向流、多层网络和二元面板数据）。我们证明了在依赖性累积满足特定条件的情况下，二元数据下的Wald统计量在渐近意义上服从$χ^2_q$分布（其中$q$为自由度）。在整个研究过程中，我们没有假设或估计任何收敛速率，因此允许得分方差矩阵的条件数趋于无穷大。此外，我们还提出了一种基于“删除一个单元”的Jackknife方法，该方法在构造上具有半正定性。这种Jackknife统计量在满足关于二元数据重复性的额外条件下也能达到相同的渐近极限；即使该条件不成立，其估计结果仍具有渐近保守性。补充材料包含了所有证明过程、蒙特卡洛实验结果（实验中估计的系数以不同的速率收敛），以及一个关于双边贸易的实证研究案例。。研究方法：回归分析、蒙特卡洛模拟、实验方法。

papers.title: The ESG Performance Affects the Cost of Corporate Debt Financing-Based on the Vertical Analysis of Trina Solar
papers.venue: Highlights in Business, Economics and Management
papers.abstract: Against the backdrop of China ' s " dual carbon " goals and the deepening of green finance, how corporate Environmental, Social, Governance (ESG) performance affects debt financing costs has become a critical issue. This study focuses on Trina Solar, a leading photovoltaic company, using its panel data and ESG reports from 2020 to 2025 for analysis. The findings reveal that while ESG scores show no simple linear correlation with interest-bearing debt ratios during rapid corporate expansion, controlling for scale, leverage, and growth, im-proved ESG performance significantly and independently reduces interest - bearing debt ratios, confirming its " net effect " of lowering financing costs through signalling. ESG disclosures do not immediately optimize debt maturity structures, as their value realization exhibits time lags and contextual dependencies, influenced by corporate strategic phases and financing priorities. For growth-stage enterprises, ESG financing optimization effects often intertwine with scale effects, requiring a gradual release through building a sustainable reputation and reducing long-term risks. This study provides dynamic micro-level evidence on the relationship between ESG and debt costs, offering decision - making references for strategic expansion - stage companies to balance scale growth with ESG investments and plan long - term financing structures.
papers.summary_zh: 【绿色金融与可持续发展】在中国“双碳”目标及绿色金融不断深化的背景下，企业环境、社会和治理（ESG）表现对债务融资成本的影响成为一个关键问题。本研究以Trina Solar（一家领先的光伏企业）为例，分析了其2020至2025年的面板数据及ESG报告。研究结果表明，在企业快速扩张期间，ESG评分与负债率之间并未呈现简单的线性关系；但在控制规模、杠杆率和增长因素后，ESG表现的提升能够显著且独立地降低负债率，从而证实了ESG通过传递积极信号来降低融资成本的“净效应”。然而，ESG信息披露并不会立即优化企业的债务期限结构，其价值实现存在时间滞后和情境依赖性，这些因素受到企业战略阶段和融资优先级的影响。对于处于成长阶段的企业而言，ESG对融资成本的优化效应往往与规模效应相互交织，需要通过建立可持续的声誉和降低长期风险来实现逐步优化。本研究提供了关于ESG与债务成本之间关系的动态微观证据，为处于战略扩张阶段的企业在实现规模增长的同时进行ESG投资及规划长期融资结构提供了决策参考。。研究方法：面板数据、优化方法。

papers.title: From Public Evidence to Contractual Outcome: First and Stable Decidability on Kalshi
papers.abstract: Public evidence can become sufficient to settle a prediction-market contract before the venue records its first determination, but the relevant boundary depends on the applicable rule version, exact release object, source hierarchy, correction history, and unfinished contract conditions. This paper defines two Kalshi clocks: first decidability, the earliest contemporaneous singleton in the rule-evidence mapping, and stable decidability, the retrospective earliest time after which the same singleton remains unchanged through finalization. A completed retrospective identification test establishes a narrow feasibility result. In a frozen blind pilot, all 25 identities and blinding checks passed and current rule text was recovered for all 25; no exact or bounded historical rule version and no exact or bounded official source-release object was recovered. The full historical recovery covered 152,694 ordinary tickers, 11,530 exact event identities, and 6,540 read-only official requests, with zero historically eligible events and zero historically eligible tickers. This is an observability result, not a claim that no market was decidable or that public evidence never existed. A completed prospective infrastructure shakedown established observation capability for three source programmes across 25 markets, with integrity revalidation of 781,266 lifecycle frames, 22 closed lower-bounded reconnect receipts, no unresolved reconnect gap, no due-but-missed official release, and an inactive price layer. Production evidence enrollment is active. The prospective sample is constructed only at enrollment close from prospectively frozen identities and pre-outcome fields; its frozen target size is selected mechanically under the registered full, reduced, exploratory, or no-go support disposition. No contractual-decidability clock, human-adjudication, price, or cross-venue result is reported here.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】在预测市场合同达成任何正式决定之前，公共证据就已经足以满足合同履行的要求；然而，这一界限的具体范围取决于所适用的规则版本、数据的发布对象、数据来源的层级结构、数据的修正历史记录以及合同尚未完成的条款。本文定义了两种用于衡量公共证据效力的“Kalshi时钟”指标：首先是“首次可判定性”（first decidability），即规则与证据映射关系中最早出现的唯一确定结果；其次是“稳定可判定性”（stable decidability），即在该时间点之后，该唯一结果在后续过程中始终保持不变。通过一项完整的回顾性验证测试，我们得出了一个关于公共证据效力的有限结论：在本次测试中，所有25个数据源的身份信息及数据完整性均得到了验证，但未能找到任何具体的历史规则版本或官方数据发布对象。整个历史数据恢复过程涵盖了152,694个普通数据条目、11,530个具体事件信息以及6,540个仅限读取的官方请求记录；同时，也确认历史上不存在任何符合合同要求的数据事件或数据条目。

此外，我们还对三个数据源在25个市场中的运行情况进行了前瞻性测试，验证了这些数据源的完整性（共验证了781,266个数据生命...。

papers.title: A Multiverse of Good and Bad Controls: Candidate Causal Graphs for Interpreting Model Robustness Analysis
papers.abstract: Model robustness analysis estimates an effect across a multiverse of specifications that pools control sets identifying the declared estimand with sets that condition on mediators or colliders. We propose stating rival assumptions about contested controls as a small set of candidate causal graphs, enumerating the adjustment sets each graph licenses, and reporting robustness metrics conditional on each graph. A finite-mixture identity splits the licensed multiverse's dispersion into within-graph and between-graph components; the between-graph share is a conditional descriptive summary whose reading depends on the candidate set, the weights, and a common estimand. Simulations examine misleading pooled robustness assessments and the limits of the decomposition. Applications to hurricane fatalities, job training, and union wages show fragility that survives every graph, instability produced by unlicensed specifications, and a fragility verdict concealing a significant premium in each adjustment-identified candidate world. An R package implements the workflow.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】模型鲁棒性分析通过构建一个包含多种规格设定的“多元宇宙”来评估估计效果，该多元宇宙将用于识别目标估计量的控制集与那些基于中介变量或混杂因素进行条件设定的控制集进行合并。我们建议将关于争议性控制变量的不同假设表述为一组有限的候选因果图，明确每张图所允许使用的调整集，并针对每张图报告相应的鲁棒性指标。通过有限混合模型，可以将多元宇宙中的数据分散性分解为图内部分和图间部分；图间部分的描述性统计结果取决于所选的候选集、各控制变量的权重以及一个共同的估计量。模拟实验揭示了误导性合并鲁棒性评估的局限性以及这种分解方法的适用范围。在飓风死亡人数、职业培训效果和工会工资等方面的应用研究表明：某些鲁棒性结论存在缺陷（即这些结论在所有候选模型中都成立），未纳入某些规格设定会导致模型结果的不稳定性；此外，某些看似稳健的结论实际上可能掩盖了某些特定调整措施所带来的显著效应。一个R语言软件包实现了上述分析流程。。研究方法：数值模拟。
